title: A Terminal for the Archive
author: Ines Ishikawa
blurb: Noor Almeida, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
